items.title: 61427_Happy Caldwell oral history interview
items.q: I said, you know, Hawk's the one inspired me on the tenor saxophone.

ctx.x: create a little something. He said, stay that way. You got a style, I'd say stay that way. You got the tone. Keep it that way. (Unintelligible) you've got the right idea.

Well, (unintelligible) your old funny idea, and the guy upstairs -- I don't understand why you go back there and talk with Hawk and he buy you drinks and he won't buy nobody else. I said, well, I had nothing to do with that. I said, you know, Hawk's the one inspired me on the tenor saxophone.

Well, I don't -- you know, it's a funny thing about that buying the drinks because I know he did, but he would -- I used to, now, I never used to talk music to him. We used to talk about Europe, and we used to talk about cars.
